# Sentzunhat Corp.

Sentzunhat Corp. is a founder-led software company based in Winnipeg, Manitoba. It builds focused products and reusable engineering foundations that give people more control over their technology and data.

## Current focus

- [Mochilada](https://sentzunhat.com/#focus): a local-first application for preserving and exploring social archives that people downloaded themselves.

## Selected work

- [HAWP](https://github.com/sentzunhat/human-ai-workflow-protocol): a durable, human-led workflow protocol for building with AI.
- [Zacatl](https://github.com/sentzunhat/zacatl): a minimal library for practical services.
